This is a rough idea I had this morning so please feel free to give me feedback - even if the feedback is that the idea sucks.

Lets say it is possible to allow posts and subverses to have an option for a location to be tagged and voted on. The voting would be for accuracy and if the location is inaccurate it can be downvoted negative and a new location can be suggested and upvoted.

Then there could be a map page that uses Google Maps to pull the location tags from /v/all users can zoom in/out of the map to see what is being discussed about any particular location.

There could even be an option to set a private location (specific or general) in your settings so you can access suggested subverses specific to that location or access suggested posts about your location of choice.

For instance, I can check the map to look at posts in cities where I have family to see if anything interesting is happening there. Then I can zoom into my area to check posts about local news. Lets say I set my location to Boston. I can get suggestions for Massachusetts or New England subverses as well as suggestions for posts in that geographic location. This could be viewed through the map or in a "suggested suvberses" tab in my settings.

So tell me, is this something that could be helpful or is this just stupid and/or a waste of time? If it would be useful, how could it be implemented? I don't have the skills to do this but If it is helpful, I am hoping someone may be able to run with it.
Mapping and Location Feature for Posts and Subverses.

Hello Voaters, and possible Redditfags like myself. Having barely just gotten into Reddit back in Feburary, I am very dismayed with the direction Ellen "Charimen" Pao is taking the site. It's a pity to see a once great site fall so hard from grace, but at the same time so wonderful to see everyone supporting a new direct competitior. I'm CynaBlitz, formerly known as Blitzstrk on Reddit. No one of importance, I just like Video Games, eating Cinnimon Rolls, and mocking Tumblrettes. I prefer PC gaming as my platform of choice.

There are some concerns I have here for Voat like the way the voting system requires you to 'level up' your SCP and CCP is the only way to gain access to downvoting, and seems rather restrictive. On the flip side it has the potential to promote more contribution's to the discussion, so maybe I'm just not used to it yet. There's also the slow servers, but we all know this one, growing pains are easily forgiven.

Some good things I really like about this site include the ability to view the dislike to like ratio on any comment, this gives a lot clearer image than a simple number that either counts up or down. The inclusion of a default Nightmode (something people have been asking for on Reddit for quite a while) is also very convient, especially since there isn't a RES CSS type add-on for Voat as far as I'm aware. But probably THE biggest thing that makes this site so appealing is the completely optional Email attachment to your account. Remember the old days of the Internet where you only needed a Username and Password? That's totally doable here and I love it!

I really look forwards to discussion a wide variety of topics with you guys in the coming years and I really hope we can all contribute to make this a better place than Reddit ever was.
